title: Uncovering the molecular mechanisms of Curcumae Rhizoma against myocardial fibrosis using network pharmacology and experimental validation.
authors: Zhang, Meng; Lu, Pengyu; Zhao, Fusen; Sun, Xuemei; Ma, Wenqi; Tang, Jiahui; Zhang, Chengbo; Ji, Haigang; Wang, Xindong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和实验验证研究莪术抗心肌纤维化的分子机制，核心是药物-疾病靶点通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Myocardial fibrosis leads to cardiac remodeling and dysfunction. Curcumae Rhizoma has been utilized in clinical trials to treat a variety of cardiovascular illnesses, although its role in myocardial fibrosis is unknown. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of current study was to explore the potential mechanism action and anti-myocardial fibrosis effects of treatment with Curcumae Rhizoma. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The chemical components in the aqueous extract from Curcumae Rhizoma were identified using GC-MS analysis. A prediction network describing the relationship between Curcumae Rhizoma and MF was established based on information collected from multiple databases. Functional enrichment analysis was performed to investigate the specific functions and pathways involved in the candidate Curcumae Rhizoma targets acting on MF, which were further validated by vivo experiments. RESULTS: There were 444 targets obtained from the 39 active ingredients in Curcumae Rhizoma, and 5691 disease targets related to MF were identified. Then, 41 key targets were determined with the PPI interaction network, which was structured from 324 overlapping gene targets. GO and KEGG analyses revealed that the p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB and TGF-beta1/Smad2/3 signaling pathways might play crucial roles in the therapeutic mechanism of MF. According to the results of molecular docking, the binding activity between core components and targets was marvelous (affinity < -6 kcal/mol). Take it a step further, the experimental validation data affirmed that Curcumae Rhizoma substantially decreased myocardial fibrosis and recovered cardiac function in the ISO-induced rats. The associated proteins expression data implied that the p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB and TGF-beta1/Smad2/3 pathways might be vital in the anti-fibrosis effect of Curcumae Rhizoma. CONCLUSION: The findings suggested that Curcumae Rhizoma diminished myocardial fibrosis by suppressing fibrosis multiplication and collagen deposition through inhibiting p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB and TGF-beta1/Smad2/3 pathways, which might be a promising therapeutic medicament for alleviating myocardial fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：心肌纤维化导致心脏重构和功能障碍。莪术（Curcumae Rhizoma）已在临床试验中用于治疗多种心血管疾病，但其在心肌纤维化中的作用尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨莪术治疗对心肌纤维化的潜在作用机制及其抗心肌纤维化效果。材料与方法：采用GC-MS分析鉴定莪术水提物中的化学成分。基于多个数据库收集的信息，建立了描述莪术与心肌纤维化（MF）关系的预测网络。进行功能富集分析以研究候选莪术靶点作用于MF的具体功能和通路，并通过体内实验进一步验证。结果：从莪术中的39种活性成分中获得了444个靶点，并鉴定了与MF相关的5691个疾病靶点。随后，通过由324个重叠基因靶点构建的PPI相互作用网络确定了41个关键靶点。GO和KEGG分析显示，p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB和TGF-beta1/Smad2/3信号通路可能在MF的治疗机制中发挥关键作用。根据分子对接结果，核心成分与靶点之间的结合活性极佳（亲和力 < -6 kcal/mol）。进一步地，实验验证数据证实，莪术显著减少了ISO诱导大鼠的心肌纤维化并恢复了心脏功能。相关蛋白表达数据表明，p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB和TGF-beta1/Smad2/3通路可能在莪术的抗纤维化效应中至关重要。结论：研究结果表明，莪术通过抑制p38 MAPK/NF-kappaB和TGF-beta1/Smad2/3通路，减少纤维化增殖和胶原沉积，从而减轻心肌纤维化，这可能是一种缓解心肌纤维化的有前景的治疗药物。
